title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Cayley source-checked slice readers plus Dedekind and Dirichlet shelf
description:
This record is a public-facing shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Arthur Cayley, Richard Dedekind, and P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet. Top-level PDFs are organized by author, work, and usable slice so readers can download individual files directly. Source TeX, build notes, audit outputs, and provenance material are collected in the artifact ZIP.

Status at a glance.

  • Cayley front-facing reader surface: [#---------] 13 volume-level slice readers are promoted as direct top-level files, compiled from 130 repaired/retyped source ranges, 3418 pages total. These are the Cayley files currently suitable as readable mathematical typesettings rather than broad draft material.
  • Cayley broader working material: [#########-] the artifact ZIP preserves the sources_tex_Vol_I through sources_tex_Vol_XIII trees, broad per-volume working PDFs, TeX chunks, and rendered slice PDFs. Those files are valuable for continuation but are not being presented as clean finished readers.
  • Dedekind and Dirichlet reader surface: [######----] Dedekind Bands I-III and one Dirichlet selected-works grouping remain present as working drafts.
  • Technical PDF/display checks: [##########] promoted Cayley readers open as normal PDF files and pass a reader-surface text sweep.
  • Mathematical proofreading: [----------] working drafts for checking and correction, not certified critical editions.

Workflow. Public-domain scans and witnesses are converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and packaged with source artifacts for inspection and correction. The public organization is by author, work, or corpus; source and build material is kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.
notes: Focused public-facing working-draft shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet. Latest update promotes Cayley volume-level slice readers and preserves broader TeX/source artifacts in Supplementary Sources - Classical Algebra and Arithmetic.zip.
